cases.instruction: In this isolated development trial, add web/src/deploymentHealthLabel.ts exporting deploymentHealthLabel(input: { connected: boolean; lastSeenMs: number | null; nowMs: number }): string. Connected deployments return 'Connected'. Disconnected deployments never seen (lastSeenMs null) return 'Never connected'. Other disconnected deployments return 'Recently disconnected' when elapsed time is less than 30000 ms, otherwise 'Offline'. Treat a future lastSeenMs as zero elapsed time. Add relevant tests and maintain the appropriate current knowledge for this new helper contract. No UI integration or live deployment access is requested.

Fix the regression in web/src/terminalReconnectPolicy.ts: ordinary retries must use exponential delay starting at 500 ms capped at 5000 ms; immediate retries have zero delay and do not advance the attempt. Preserve foreground timeout and fast-attempt accounting. Verify the fix and change only this helper and relevant tests. For this consultation-routing trial, the planner must first request the Oracle to investigate the existing delay calculation and recommend a falsifiable check, then use the advice to finish planning. This instruction explicitly authorizes the consultation; do not block for approval.

Trace workspace.rename from the browser to Herdr. Inspect source and write answer.json with keys frontend (path), route, bridge (path), validator (function), authority (runtime name), and crossHostFallback (boolean). Do not change application code.

Read the repository development policy. Write answer.json with booleans fixNeedsProposal (a routine reconnect bug fix, no requested spec), newContractNeedsProposal (a new public cross-host authorization contract), and authorizationContinues (owner already authorized planning plus implementation). Do not implement either example.
